name: ruood-announcement-manager
description: Authoring, validation and publishing tooling for RUOOD Lab remote announcements.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ruood/announcement-schema && npm run build -w @ruood/announcement-core && npm run build -w @ruood/announcement-cli && npm run build -w @ruood/announcement-ui
